name: Women Long Hair
overview: Scripture distinguishes between male and female roles and appearances, emphasizing that women should not adopt what pertains to men, as seen in Deuteronomy 22:5. While the Bible records instances of personal vows affecting hair, such as Paul shaving his head (Acts 18:18), it also underscores identity in God's image (Genesis 5:3) and living according to the Spirit (Romans 8:14). These verses collectively affirm that outward expressions, including hair, reflect deeper spiritual truths and distinctions ordained by God.
